question: Where is gallery located within 160 kilometers along the route from Dwarfskill Preserve, Milford, PA to Chatham Square, New York, NY?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois WHERE tourism ILIKE '%gallery%' AND ST_Intersects( geometry, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Dwarfskill Preserve%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Milford%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Chatham Square%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ) ), 160000 ) :: geography );
